items.title: File Widerspruch (objection) against the hedge-trimming order
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Landratsamt Beispielkreis, Landratsplatz 2, 83043 Musterau, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 29.06.2026, sent by an authority by post: deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG, since 2025), i.e. Fri 03.07.2026 (no weekend shift for the delivery-fiction day itself). The one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 04.07.2026, and ends one month later on the same-numbered day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Mon 03.08.2026. That day is a business day, so no further shift applies. This date has already passed relative to today (26.09.2026).

items.title: Trim the hedge back to the property boundary
items.quote: Wir bitten um Erledigung innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: This deadline is conditional: it runs from 'Bestandskraft' (the order becoming final/unappealable), not from a fixed date. Assuming no Widerspruch was filed, Bestandskraft occurs the day after the one-month Widerspruch period expires, i.e. Tue 04.08.2026. Counting the 3-week compliance period starts the day after that event (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 05.08.2026, and the period ends 3 weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 1/2 BGB): Tue 25.08.2026. If a Widerspruch was in fact lodged, Bestandskraft (and this clock) has not yet begun and the true due date would be later, depending on when the Widerspruch proceedings conclude.

warnings: Both computed dates (Widerspruch deadline 03.08.2026 and hedge-trimming deadline 25.08.2026) fall before today's date (26.09.2026); the recipient should check whether they already responded to or complied with this order, or whether a Widerspruch is still pending, since that would change when the compliance period actually starts.

The hedge-trimming deadline depends on 'Bestandskraft' (the order becoming final), which itself depends on whether a Widerspruch was filed; the computed date of 25.08.2026 assumes no Widerspruch was lodged and is only the earliest plausible reading.

The letter states an IBAN (DE15 7115 0000 0000 0203 04) in the footer, but no payment or amount is actually demanded in this letter; verify independently before ever sending money based on this account number.
